i’m right here

snippet.title: paris jackson - zombies in love (acapella)
snippet.description:
lyrics:

so much hate and pain to fight through 
a hopeless cause and tune to sway to 
dreams of all the things we'd be but the common goal is so deadly

 zombies in love we're zombies in love

i can't find a way to fill this

nodding off and rearranging 
nothing changes if nothing changes
a den of dust, my disposition 
is fading fast in this addiction

zombies in love 
we're zombies in love

i don't mind the poison's still
 this love
this love 
this love of ours love

fading out to stay right here with you (in love)

snippet.title: paris jackson’s 5 year sober anniversary ♡
snippet.description:
(instagram caption) 

hi, i'm pk and i'm an alcoholic and a heroin addict.
today marks 5 years clean & sober from all drugs and alcohol. to say that i'm thankful would be a poor euphemism. gratitude hardly scratches the surface. it's because i'm sober that i get to smile today, i get to make music. i get to experience the joy of loving my dogs and cat. i get to feel heartbreak in all it's glory. i get to grieve. i get to laugh. i get to dance. i get to trust. i feel the sun on my skin and it's warm. i've found that life keeps happening regardless of whether i'm sober or not, but today i get to show up for it.
here's a little snapshot of what has been possible because of my sobriety, and my god i can't believe i almost missed it all.
thanks
1•7•20
